adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the email send is wrapped in `try { await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests); } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }`, which swallows failures and discards the caught `err` (no logging of details, no rethrow, no reporting). This is a real, diff-grounded issue affecting observability/error handling, but it doesn’t conclusively break the core “add guests” mutation since the booking update and calendar update already occurred.
